newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says Ukraine lifts military overflight ban.
newsitem.headline: Russia says Ukraine lifts military overflight ban.

text.p: Ukraine on Saturday lifted a ban imposed late last month on Russian military aircraft flying over its airspace, a Russian Defence Ministry spokesman said.
He told Reuters an accord was reached after telephone talks between the chief of the Russian general staff, Viktor Samsonov, and his Ukrainian counterpart, Alexander Zatynayko.
Ukraine slapped the restrictions on after alleging that Russian jets flew unauthorised sorties over sectors of the Black Sea during a recent NATO exercise with Ukraine.

The dispute came as Moscow and Kiev were trying to smoothe over long-running differences and just days after Russian President Boris Yeltsin agreed to finally visit Ukraine after numerous cancellations in the past two years.

The main effect of the Ukrainian no-fly ban had been to disrupt supplies for the 6,000-strong Russian peacekeeping garrison in the ethnic Russian Dnestr region of Moldova, which is cut off from the Black Sea by a strip of Ukrainian territory.
Yeltsin promised last week to visit Ukraine in early June despite a dragging dispute between the two sides over division of the former Soviet Black Sea fleet.
